Hello 👋

I live near Itaewon with my lovely cat. I used to share this home with my sister, but since she left for a working holiday, her room is ready for a new guest. Up to two people can stay comfortably — please note there's one queen bed to share.

Please check before booking

  • 🗓️Move-in available from late September
  • 🐾A sweet, chill cat lives here — may not suit allergies or discomfort around animals
  • ⛰️The hill up to the house is steep (~3 min walk) — we call it the "Ancient Tea Horse Road"
  • 🚕Alleys are narrow — plan to walk ~3 min out to catch or call a taxi
  • ❄️A/C is in the living room; cracking your bedroom door cools it quickly
  • 🏠Host lives on-site — happy to recommend local music bars and old-school Korean restaurants
  • 📝Lease contract provided
  • 📮Resident registration (전입신고) available
  • 🔒Digital door lock and a CCTV camera at the entrance, plus a fire extinguisher on hand
  • 🚫No on-site parking
  • 👥Friends can visit — just give me a heads-up beforehand
  • 🚬Smoking is okay by the front entrance
  • 🌙Please keep it quiet after midnight
💼 Stays of 3+ months welcome. A security deposit is required, with a discounted monthly rent in return.

About me

I'm a graphic designer, currently juggling work and study — so weekdays are busy and I keep things quiet at home. On weekends I'm usually out catching live music or a show, and I love a good music bar. My English isn't perfect, but I've made a lot of foreign friends here in Korea and still visit them from time to time — always happy to have an international housemate 🌏
